title: Written Exam Preparation and Mock Written Paper
lead: Prepares the written paper of 27.10.2026. Contains how to answer, a bank of ready theory answers for every topic of the module, the syllabus topics that the slides only touch (power management, optimisation, memory use, debugging, trends), and a full mock written paper (30 multiple choice and 6 structured questions) with model answers, drawn from all lessons and exercises.
